title: ReviewerVerdict
description: Output contract for prompts/04-reviewer-judge.md. Routing: pass + confidence > 0.9 proceed; 0.6-0.9 proceed + flag; < 0.6 or fail block + escalate. Max 2 automatic revision retries.

verdict.description: fail = hallucination, banned claim, or compliance issue. revise = fixable voice/quality issue.

reason.description: The specific sentence and the specific rule, e.g. 'references a 40% booking increase that appears nowhere in the source data'.

checks.description: Per-category result, for tracking failure types over time.

unsupported_claims.description: Claims found in the draft with no source in the input data (empty when faithfulness passes).

revision_instructions.description: Concrete fix for the writer when verdict=revise; null otherwise.
